name: Valle de Valdelucio (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, green and yellow in the proportions 1:1:2, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Valdelucio (a castle on green within a bordure of roundels, above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Valdelucio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valle de Valdelucio arms — castle within a bordure of roundels, above waves
